messages:
Sam: starting the LON3 GPU onboarding. 8x A100 provisioned, want a minimal-traffic validation pass and signoff before handing to customer ops. can someone run the quick checklist and call out blockers?
Jess: noted. i can take the smoke list. planning to validate networking, kube nodes, nvml health, and a tiny qps load test.
deploy-bot: cluster lon3-gpu-pool created -> pool-id: pool-9f3d. autoscaler attached. image: redwood-runtime:v3.1.2
Maria: i'll validate VPC routes, NACLs, and inter-AZ latency. will run iperf and traceroute. if we see >5ms intra-az maybe a misroute.
Ben: SLOs for this run: p95 inference <80ms for 128-token requests, node readiness >= 95%, no GPU ECC errors, and scheduler error rate <0.5%.
Jess: smoke checklist (running now):
- kubectl get nodes -> all Ready?
- kubectl describe node for taints/labels
- curl http://lon3-health.internal/ready (should return 200 and {\"ok\":true})
- nvidia-smi on each node -> GPUs visible, drivers match 535.x
- run small perf job: `curl -s -X POST http://lon3-infer.internal/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-mini","prompt":"hi","max_tokens":16}'` -> expect <80ms p95
- run prefix cache sanity: warm cache, make a repeat call, check latency drop
- iperf3 between nodes -> baseline >9Gbps intra-az
- check node disk pressure and kubelet restarts

Jess: posting results as I go. first: kubectl shows 8 nodes Ready.
Jess: nvidia-smi OK on 7 nodes, 1 node shows PCIe link down for GPU0. throwing an event  -> tagging node gpu-lon3-07 for hardware swap.
Maria: iperf3 results: AZ-a <-> AZ-a median 10.2Gbps, AZ-a <-> AZ-b 9.1Gbps, max RTT 3.8ms. traceroute shows one hop in provider network with 2ms spike but transient.
Ben: good. the hardware swap will need schedule. can we proceed with 7 nodes and de-rate capacity? update autoscaler min to 6/ max 8 for now.
Sam: ok proceed with 7 for initial handoff, note capacity in runbook and ticket hardware-swap-142.
oncall-bot: perf-job-215 completed. p50=36ms p95=72ms p99=120ms.
Jess: p95 for our tiny job is 72ms which meets the gate <80ms. p99 spikes due to cold-start; we'll document for optimization.
Jess: kubelet restart count = 0 across nodes, disk usage < 40% on all nodes.
Maria: security checks: SGs only allow control plane and GPU-API subnets; no 0.0.0.0/0 on management ports. KMS integrated for model keys.
Ben: cost sanity: estimate monthly GPU hours at current baseline (7 nodes idle baseline) ~ 11250 GPU-hours -> cost est $X (placeholder). please add finance tag `lon3-pilot` and set billing alert at 20% over forecast.
Sam: logged handoff checklist in ops-runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/lon3-onboard (private). created ticket ENG-4573 for hardware swap and ENG-4574 for p99 regression investigation.
Jess: final pre-handoff items: add route53 health check, register cluster in console, enable per-token tracing for 24h.
Ben: thumbs up from SRE side after gating:
- SLO gate p95 <80ms: PASS
- node readiness >=95%: PASS (7/8 nodes, replacing 1)
- GPU ECC/errors: PASS (except flagged node)
- network bandwidth: PASS

Sam: thanks all. i'll do a short handoff call at 1500UTC and then mark ready for customer ops with the caveat of 1 queued hardware swap. :thumbsup:
Maria: will follow up on provider ticket for flaky hop. leaving notes in the runbook. :mag:
oncall-bot: incident monitor set to 72h elevated telemetry for lon3 (reason: new region bringup).
Jess: adding quick remediation snippets to runbook:
```
# Check GPU health
ssh admin@gpu-lon3-07
sudo nvidia-smi -q | grep -i 'ecc errors' -A2
# Quick node drain + replace
kubectl cordon gpu-lon3-07
kubectl drain gpu-lon3-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# Scale pool while replacement in progress
rwdctl pool update --id pool-9f3d --min 6 --max 8
```
Sam: good work. leaving thread open for any late blockers before 1500UTC.
